notes.title: 🐾 Derpy’s Big Adventure: We’re Heading to Gamescom 2025!
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited to share that “Cat Me If You Can” will be showcased at Gamescom 2025 as part of the Indie Arena Booth!


It’s your chance to play the Cat Me If You Can demo & snap a pic with our fluffiest star.


In case you haven’t met him yet, this is Derpy, the derpiest cat you’ll meet at Gamescom (and yes, he loves selfies). 🐱



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479848/c511c6240cc85044407a22e1fa271d86e39e8f1e.png"]


When & Where: 
📅 August 20–24, 2025 

📍 Koelnmesse, Cologne – Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019


What’s in store?
We’re bringing a brand-new demo with exclusive gameplay content, plus a few fluffy surprises. You’ll get the chance to:

🎮 Play the game before release

🤝 Meet the Cosmic Stag team in person

🐱 Meet (and take a photo with!) our resident plushie superstar, Derpy the Cat



📸 Tag your pics with:

#CatMeIfYouCan

#DerpyAtGamescom

for a chance to be featured on our socials.


Why we’re so excited: 
Gamescom is one of the largest gaming events in the world, and being part of it is a dream come true for our small team. We’ve poured so much love into Cat Me If You Can, and we can’t wait to see players’ first reactions to our new content.


How you can join the fun:
💜 Wishlist Cat Me If You Can on Steam

📲 Follow us on social media for live Gamescom updates

🐾 Stop by our booth and say hi to Derpy!



We’re counting down the days, see you in Cologne!

The Cosmic Stag Team

notes.title: Cat Me If You Can is heading to Gamescom 2025!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Cat Me If You Can will be part of Gamescom 2025 at the Indie Arena Booth!


Catch us at Hall 10.2 at Koelnmesse, Cologne, Germany 

🗓 August 20–24, 2025 

📍 Indie Arena Booth – Hall 10.2 


✨ What to Expect:


We’ll be showcasing exciting new updates, exclusive content, and a hands-on playable demo. 
Including a brand new map and lots of fluffy surprises! 👀 

If you're attending, don’t miss your chance to sneak by, find some hidden cats, and meet the devs behind the whiskers. We’d love to connect with you in person!

Check out the official Indie Arena Booth Trailer featuring the many amazing indie titles that will be with us at Gamescom! 

Join our Discord if you want to stay up to date and follow along with the development: JOIN THE DISCORD


Cheers
The Cosmic Stag Games Team

notes.title: Announcing Cat Me If You Can!
notes.content:
We are proudly announcing our new game: Cat Me If You Can

[previewyoutube=hb6PjzZXQTw;full][/previewyoutube]

Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.


Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170490/Cat_Me_If_You_Can/

Cat Me If You Can is set to launch in Q3 this year with a public demo coming prior in Q2. We can't wait for you to play and enjoy this game and are looking forward to all your feedback 😻

Join our Discord if you want to follow along with the development: https://discord.gg/2gzUWmbadJ

Cheers
The Cosmic Stag Games Team
